5×7 [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]] and [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can]] Reflections I box toppers on the table, with a regular-size Hunt Down at left. Still at 2:30 of ''Guide - SW:CCG Collection - Oversized/Undersized Cards''.

Fair use of a video still for identification of the physical 5×7 objective box toppers on [[Oversized cards]] and [[Reflections]].
